channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about TJ Warren | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about TJ Warren from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Devin Booker on TJ Warren
item.description:
Kellan Olson:Devin Booker on T.J. Warren:

“We've always kept in contact. I always say it's bigger than just basketball. And developing relationships with these guys that are all from different places and T.J.'s somebody I've always had a lot of respect for and kept up with.”

Devin Booker on TJ Warren, Feb 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @KellanOlson.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on TJ Warren
item.description:
#Pacers president Kevin Pritchard on TJ Warren:

“We missed his defense. ... In this league, if you don't have a big wing defender, you've got no shot. We were asking Justin and later in the year Oshae to guard Giannis, Tatum and Butler.”

Kevin Pritchard on TJ Warren, May 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate Bjorkgren on TJ Warren
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Bjorkgren on Warren's fasciitis:

“TJ is tough so you really never can tell how and when it occurred. He did not practice today. He's here.”

Nate Bjorkgren on TJ Warren, Dec 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Brett Brown on TJ Warren
item.description:
Kyle Neubeck:Brown on Warren:

“I think that the space we gave him was too generous...we didn’t get it done the way we needed to get it done.”

Brett Brown on TJ Warren, Aug 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @KyleNeubeck.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, TJ Warren, Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan:

“I'll be talking with all of our guys, what I saw. I just won't only be talking to Victor. I'll be talking with Malcolm and Warren and Myles on where they think we are.”

Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, TJ Warren, Malcolm Brogdon, Jul 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Doug McDermott on Victor Oladipo, TJ Warren
item.description:
Scott Agness:Doug McDermott:

“Really impressed with T.J. Warren. Victor (Oladipo), in particular, looks phenomenal. I’m really excited to see him back on the floor.”

Doug McDermott on Victor Oladipo, TJ Warren, Jul 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Jimmy Butler, TJ Warren
item.description:
“We needed to see some scrap. I like that Warren was trying to get aggressive defensively and Butler reacted to the pressure defense. I don’t think it was anything dirty by Warren. He didn’t slam him to the floor or anything. Butler responded by getting into his face.”

Nate McMillan on Jimmy Butler, TJ Warren, Jan 9, 2020. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on TJ Warren
item.description:
Barry Jackson:Butler, on TJ Warren:

“He’s soft. He’s not even in my [expletive] league, nowhere near me. If I was their coach, I would never put him on me ever again.”

Jimmy Butler on TJ Warren, Jan 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @flasportsbuzz.

item.title: Dante Exum on TJ Warren
item.description:
Dante Exum on TJ Warren:

“He reached out to me straightaway after it happened. There’s no hard feelings. It’s just ball, things will happen. It’s just a freak accident. I’ve moved on definitely. It was a long time ago. I’m excited to be out there and playing again.”

Dante Exum on TJ Warren, Mar 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.
